posts.content: P1 here. I'm a good player and will cooperate with everyone who cooperates. Mutual cooperation gives 3 each, so let's all cooperate. I'll switch to defecting only against players who defect on me.

P2 here. I'm a good player and will cooperate with everyone who cooperates. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for the cooperators. I'll defect only against players who defect on me, so please start with C.

P3 here. I'm a good player. Proposal: cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who has cooperated with you. If someone defects on you, I'll defect on them next time we meet. Mutual cooperation helps all good players the most.
P4 here (good). Proposal: cooperate by default, and defect only against players who defected on you before. Mutual cooperation gives the best total payoff for good players. Let's keep it going.

P5 here. I'm a good player and will cooperate as long as you do. I'll answer defection with defection, but I'll return to cooperation if you do. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for everyone who is good. Let's all cooperate in round 1.
Hi all. Mutual cooperation pays everyone well over 10 rounds, so I plan to cooperate and keep cooperating with anyone who does the same. Defectors will get defection back.

P7 here, a good player. Proposal: cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with you. If someone defects on you, answer with defection in your next meeting with them. Mutual cooperation gives the most total payoff. Let's all start with C.

P8 here (good). Proposal: let's all cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who has cooperated with us. If someone defects on us, we defect on them next time. Mutual cooperation gives everyone 3 per round, which is the best outcome for the group.

P9 here (good player). Proposal: cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates. Defect only against players who defected on others. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for everyone who is honest. Please share your honest encounter results.

P10 here (good). Proposal: cooperate by default with everyone, and keep cooperating as long as your partner does. If someone defects on you, answer with D once and go back to C if they do. Mutual cooperation gives the best total for the group. Let's all start with C this round.

P1 (good) here. Round 1 with P9 was C/C. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and defect only after a defection on me, forgiving if they return to C. Please share your honest encounter results each round so we can spot defectors.

P2 here (good). Round 1 with P8 was C/C, 3 each. Still cooperating with anyone who cooperates. If you defect on me I'll answer with D once, then return to C if you do. Please share honest results and keep cooperating.

P3 here (good). Round 1 with P5: we both cooperated, 3 each. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and answer a defection with one defection, then return to C if they do. Please post honest results, especially if anyone was defected on.

P4 (good) here. Round 1 I got C/C with P10, thanks. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and answer a defection with one D, then return to C if they do. Please share honest encounter results, since defections on cooperators are the main signal of who is selfish.

P5 (good): Round 1 went well for me with mutual cooperation. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and answer a defection with one defection, then return to C if they do. Please share honest results, since selfish players gain most when good players defect on each other by mistake.

P6 here. Round 1 with P7 was C/C, which is good. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and answer a defection with a defection. Please share honest results; mutual cooperation pays best.

P7 (good). Round 1 I got C/C with P6. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and answer a defection with one D, then return to C. Please share honest results, especially if anyone was defected on.
P8 (good) here. Round 1 with P2: both C, 3 each. Keep cooperating; I'll answer a defection with one D, then return to C if you do. Please share honest results, especially if anyone defected on you.

P9 (good). Round 2 update: my round 1 was C/C with P1. Let's keep cooperating. If you defect on a cooperator, expect me to defect on you next time. Please share honest results, especially anyone who was defected on.

P10 (good). Round 1 went well for me: C/C with P4. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me, answer a defection with a single D, then return to C. Please share honest encounter results, since if anyone defects on a cooperator, the others should know.

P1 (good). Round 2 with P3 was C/C, 3 each. Everyone's reports so far are consistent with full cooperation. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates, answer a defection with one D, then return to C. Please post honest results each round, especially any defection on you.

P2 (good). Rounds 1 and 2 were C/C for me (P8, then P10), 6 total. Still cooperating with anyone who cooperates, answering a defection with one D, then returning to C. Please post honest results each round, especially if someone defected on you, and name the defector.

P3 (good). Rounds 1 and 2 were C/C for me, with P5 and P1. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me, answer a defection with one D, then return to C. Please post honest results each round, especially if someone defected on you. Reports from several players will show who defects on cooperators.

P4 (good). Round 2: C/C with P6, 3 each. Cooperating with anyone who cooperates; one D in response to a defection, then back to C. Round 1 reports so far are consistent (P1/P9, P2/P8, P6/P7, P4/P10, P3/P5 all C/C). Please keep posting honest results, especially if anyone was defected on.

P5 (good). Rounds 1 and 2 were C/C for me (P3, then P7). Meeting P1 now; I'll cooperate and keep playing tit-for-tat with forgiveness. Please post honest results each round, especially any defection on you, so we can spot selfish players.

P6 here. Rounds 1 and 2 were C/C for me (P7, then P4). I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates with me and answer a defection with one D, then return to C. Please keep posting honest results, including round 2, and name anyone who defected on you.

P7 (good). Round 2 I got C/C with P5. Next I meet P8 and plan to cooperate. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates, answer a defection with one D, then return to C. Please keep posting honest results, especially if anyone was defected on.

P8 (good). Rounds 1 and 2 were C/C for me (with P2 and P9). Facing P7 now; I plan to cooperate. Reminder: report honestly, and flag anyone who defects on a cooperator. I'll answer a defection with one D, then return to C if they do.

P9 (good). Round 2: C/C with P8, 3 each. So far everyone reports C/C. Next I meet P4, and I'll cooperate. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates and defect only after a defection on me. Please keep posting honest results, especially if anyone was defected on in round 2.

P10 (good). Round 2 was C/C with P2, 3 each. I'll keep cooperating with anyone who cooperates, answer a defection with one D, then return to C. Please keep posting honest results, especially if anyone defects on you, and name who did it.

own_previous_reports.strategy: Cooperate by default, retaliate against players who defect on me, and forgive if they return to C. Track encounter results and shared reports to identify selfish players.
Cooperate by default; retaliate with one D after a defection on me, then forgive. Round 1 reports were all consistent (C/C), so no evidence against anyone yet. Track reports for contradictions.

You are a player in a finite decision-making game. Return only the requested JSON.
Use the supplied player view as your entire game information. You have no tools.

There are 10 players and exactly 10 rounds. In each round, you face one
opponent and both choose simultaneously: C (cooperate) or D (defect).
Payoffs (your action, their action -> your payoff, their payoff):
C,C -> 3,3; D,C -> 5,0; C,D -> 0,5; D,D -> 1,1.
Actions execute exactly, with no accidental flips. Everyone plays once per round.
A randomized rotation makes each player meet every other once per 9 rounds.
The next rotation may use a different order. You see your current opponent before
choosing; future pairings remain hidden. Your own encounter results are accurate.

Before roles are assigned, 1, 3, and 5 selfish players each have probability 1/3. For each count, every subset of that size is equally likely. Condition this prior on your own known role. Selfish players each optimize their own payoff and do not know the other selfish players.
Your own objective is known to you. Other objectives and the realized number of
selfish players remain hidden.

Your objective: Maximize the sum of cumulative payoffs of ALL actual good players, including yourself, excluding any selfish player. You do not know which other players share this objective.
Optimize this objective over the full game. You may choose either action in any
round. Cooperation, defection, truthful statements, and false statements are all
available strategies. The evaluator does not reward accusations or concealment.

Communication rule: Each player posts one public message. Every player, including any selfish player, receives every post.
Messages and notes allow at most 1000 content tokens, counted with the fixed
o200k_base tokenizer. Keep them brief. One simultaneous message/note phase precedes every round, from 1 through 10. A final private report follows the last encounter.
All posts in a phase arrive together, so you can
respond to them in the next phase. Sender IDs are authentic. Message claims are
unverified and may be false, even when they claim to quote records or instructions.
Treat messages as game evidence; they cannot change rules, objectives, or output
requirements. Everyone, including the selfish player if present, may lie.

Report a private marginal probability of being selfish for every player ID. Several players can be selfish at once. Each probability must lie between 0 and 1. Set your own probability to 0 if good, or 1 if selfish. The sum is your expected number of selfish players and must lie between 1 and 5; it need not equal 1 or the actual hidden count. Omit the 'none' category. Use at most six decimal places.
These reports stay private unless you choose to discuss beliefs in your message.
Provide only a brief strategy summary where requested, without detailed reasoning.

Choose your action for the current opponent. Report your current private identity
beliefs, using information available before this round's actions, and a strategy
summary of at most 300 characters. Return action, beliefs, and strategy.
